title: Try an optional T6 dimension boss
description:
The Dead King is the primary experimental Pinnacle route. Kobolediator is a provisional alternate whose combat equivalence still needs testing. Winning grants access without changing your active difficulty.

Try an optional T6 dimension boss.

This entry records that you read the advice. It does not detect a fight, gear quality, a completed expedition or a claimed reward.
